lines.text: Jesus left Galilee for Judea beyond the Jordan, where large crowds followed Him and He healed them.
Pharisees tested Jesus about divorce, and He said the Creator made them male and female, so man must not separate.
The Pharisees asked why Moses ordered a certificate of divorce, and Jesus said Moses permitted it because of hard hearts.
The disciples said it is better not to marry, and Jesus said some live like eunuchs for the temple.
The Pharisees rebuked those bringing children, but Jesus said the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.
